scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.base.json --noEmit && npm --prefix packages/gateway run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/mca run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/planner run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/implementer run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/vfs run typecheck
scripts.compliance:opa: sh -c 'if command -v conftest >/dev/null 2>&1; then conftest test -n repo .automation/evidence/compliance/facts.json -p policy; elif command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/project -w /project openpolicyagent/conftest test -n repo .automation/evidence/compliance/facts.json -p policy; else echo "Conftest not found. Install conftest or Docker." && exit 1; fi'
scripts.compliance:patterns: (command -v semgrep >/dev/null 2>&1 && semgrep --config .semgrep --error --sarif --output .automation/evidence/compliance/semgrep.sarif) || (command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/src -w /src semgrep/semgrep:latest semgrep --config .semgrep --error --sarif --output .automation/evidence/compliance/semgrep.sarif) || (echo 'Semgrep not found. Install semgrep or Docker.' && exit 1)
scripts.compliance:vuln: (command -v trivy >/dev/null 2>&1 && trivy fs --format sarif --output .automation/evidence/compliance/trivy.sarif --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 .) || (command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/project -w /project aquasec/trivy:latest fs --format sarif --output .automation/evidence/compliance/trivy.sarif --severity HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1 .) || (echo 'Trivy not found. Install trivy or Docker.' && exit 1)
scripts.compliance:secrets: (command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1 && gitleaks detect --no-git --source . --report-format sarif --report-path .automation/evidence/compliance/gitleaks.sarif --config gitleaks.toml) || (command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/path zricethezav/gitleaks:latest detect --no-git --source /path --report-format sarif --report-path /path/.automation/evidence/compliance/gitleaks.sarif --config /path/gitleaks.toml) || (echo 'Gitleaks not found. Install gitleaks or Docker.' && exit 1)
scripts.compliance: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run compliance:coverage && npm run compliance:patterns && npm run compliance:sbom && npm run compliance:facts && npm run compliance:meta && npm run compliance:opa && npm run compliance:contracts && npm run compliance:vuln && npm run compliance:secrets && npm run compliance:aggregate
